advisory.summary: module-resolution RCE: the catch-all page route reaches requireModule, which require()s an attacker-controlled path with no bundles-directory containment (Next.js < 5.1.0)

acquisition.notes: Fixed variant at Next.js 5.1.0: the advisory-named sink requireModule is removed (PR #3776 replaced it with requirePage plus a getPagePath bundles-directory containment guard; PR #3787 deleted the unrestricted resolver). The render hop now calls requirePage and requireModule no longer resolves anywhere in the tree.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_not_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The fix removes the requireModule sink from the tree (renamed to the guarded requirePage with a bundles-directory containment check), so ResolveDependencySymbols for requireModule resolves nothing and no ingress-to-sink path exists -- reachable_candidate flips to not_exploitable by symbol removal. Reasoned rather than proven because non-exploitability proof requires the two-trace. KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
